items.source: Mark the application context of the supplied test context as dirty and set REINJECT_DEPENDENCIES_ATTRIBUTE in the test context to true.
items.translation: 标记提供的测试上下文的应用上下文为脏，并将测试上下文中的 REINJECT_DEPENDENCIES_ATTRIBUTE 设置为 true。

items.source: Perform the actual work for AbstractTestExecutionListener.beforeTestClass(TestContext) and AbstractTestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext) by dirtying the context if appropriate (i.e., according to the required mode).
items.translation: 执行 `AbstractTestExecutionListener.beforeTestClass(TestContext)` 和 `AbstractTestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext)`，并在适当时通过脏化上下文（即根据所需的模式）来执行此操作。

items.source: Perform the actual work for AbstractTestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext) and AbstractTestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext) by dirtying the context if appropriate (i.e., according to the required modes).
items.translation: 执行 `AbstractTestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext)` 和 `AbstractTestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext)`，并在适当时通过脏化上下文（即根据所需的模式）来执行此操作。

items.source: testContext - the test context whose application context should potentially be marked as dirty; never null
items.translation: testContext - 可能需标记为脏的测试上下文的应用程序上下文；绝不null

items.source: requiredClassMode - the class mode required for a context to be marked dirty in the current phase; never null
items.translation: requiredClassMode - 当前阶段将上下文标记为脏所需的类模式；永远不为 null。

items.source: The core functionality for this class was extracted from DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener in Spring Framework 4.2.
items.translation: 此类的核心功能是从 Spring Framework 4.2 中的 DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener 提取的。

items.source: The default implementation returns Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE, thereby ensuring that custom listeners are ordered after default listeners supplied by the framework.
items.translation: 默认实现返回Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE，从而确保自定义监听器被安排在框架提供的默认监听器之后。

items.source: The default implementation returns Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE, thereby ensuring that custom listeners are ordered after default listeners supplied by the framework. Can be overridden by subclasses as necessary.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE，从而确保自定义监听器位于框架提供的默认监听器之后。可根据需要由子类重写。
`getOrder` 在类 `AbstractTestExecutionListener` 中

items.source: hierarchyMode - the context cache clearing mode to be applied if the context is part of a hierarchy; may be null
items.translation: hierarchyMode - 如果上下文属于层次结构，则应用此上下文缓存清除模式；可为 null。

items.source: requiredMethodMode - the method mode required for a context to be marked dirty in the current phase; never null
items.translation: requiredMethodMode - 当前阶段标记上下文为脏所需的方法模式；永远不为 null。

items.source: Exception - allows any exception to propagate
items.translation: Exception - 允许任何异常传播。

items.source: testContext - the test context whose application context should be marked as dirty
items.translation: testContext - 其应用程序上下文应被标记为脏的测试上下文
`getOrder` 接口 `Ordered` 中
